headline: Approved cutting the Artist in the Alley fee to $75 and allowing second-floor businesses to set up retail tents.
summary: Commissioners also unanimously approved the nomination of Chris Haessly as treasurer. Reports covered the budget, which staff said is tight going into the holiday season, and upcoming holiday events.
decisions: Approved adjusting the outdoor retail vending program to allow second-floor businesses to participate, unanimously.
Approved reducing the Artist in the Alley annual fee from $400 to $75, unanimously.
Approved the nomination of Chris Haessly for treasurer, unanimously.

1. Agenda  
Call to Order: 09:07 
Action: Motion to Approve Agenda  
Motion by: C. Haessly   
Seconded by: E. Monsen   
Vote: Passed Unanimously  
 
2. Adopt Minutes  
Action: Motion to Adopt Minutes 
Motion by: C. Haessly   
Seconded by: L. Magoon   
Vote: Passed Unanimously  
 
3. Public Forum  
 
1. No Public Forum
Church Street Marketplace Commission Minutes   
 
 
 
 
Commissioner’s Items  
 
1. C. Haessly voiced opinion that meetings should be livestreamed to the public on Town 
Meeting TV. He is exploring the cost for this. 
2. C. Haessly notes City Place Phase 2 has frontage on Church Street. Would like to add an 
agenda item regarding this for a future meeting. 
3. C. Haessly would like to see Veteran’s Banners for Church Street Marketplace next 
November for Veteran’s Day.  
4. C. Haessly spoke with a Downtown bartender no insurance, called for Downtown Worker’s 
Fund to provide assistance to the workers who keep our downtown running.  
5. J. Grossman, Vermont Agency for Commerce and Community Development (ACCD) does 
economic development all over the state but is not that active in Burlington and offers no 
retail support. No trade association for small retail, could Church Street Marketplace fill in 
the gaps?  
6. M. Moore, thoughts on OPC. Wants OPC staff to attending meeting and open up dialog.  
C. Haessly responds noting Ward 3 meeting tonight.  
 
4. Second Floor Business Retail Tents Memo 
 
1. S. McGinnis gave background on retail tents. Historically only 1st floor businesses have 
been  allowed to have retail tents; have only allowed 1st floor tenants this option given 
that Marketplace fees are only assessed on 1 st floor square footage; there has been a 
request by a second-floor business to allow 2nd floor businesses to have a retail tent.  
Structure for the 2nd floor retail tent program is proposed to    require they pay higher fees 
and have written permission from abutting 1st floor businesses. There are a limited 
number of locations in which this could work on the marketplace.  
 
2. L. Magoon asked clarifying questions about specific details. Shares concerns but is not 
necessarily opposed. M. Bouchett acknowledges concerns, has similar feelings.  
E. Monsen, B. Holt, M. Moore and J. Grossman share similar opinions.  
 
Action: Move to Adopt Recommendations of CSM Staff to Adjust Outdoor Retail Vending 
Program to Allow 2nd Floor Businesses to Participate   
Motion by: C. Haessly  
Seconded by: L. Magoon  
Vote: Passed Unanimously  
 
5. Artist in the Alley Fee Adjustment  
 
1. S. McGinnis shared intent to reduce fee to $75 from $400 annually to increase 
participation. Noted four artists have gone through application process and stopped at 
the payment step in the  application. 
 
2. E. Monsen asked how a $75 fee vs $400 fee was arrived at. S. McGinnis noted $30 market 
fee at the BTV Market  and how this new fee would be more closely aligned with this also
Church Street Marketplace Commission Minutes   
 
 
noting background check fees are required. A. Bacher noted that insurance is also 
required which is an additional cost for the vendors. S. McGinnis commented on first 
month free is more of a trial period for vendors. Discussion Ensued regarding fee.  
 
Action: Move to Reduce Fee for Artist in the Alley Program  
Motion by: M. Bouchett  
Seconded by: C. Haessly  
Vote: Passed Unanimously  
 
6. Vote on New Treasurer  
 
1. Nominations for Treasurer. M. Bouchett nominated C. Haessly. 
 
Action: Nomination of Chris Haessly for Treasurer  
Motion by: M. Bouchett  
Seconded by: L. Magoon  
Vote: Passed Unanimously  
 
2. C. Haessly thanked commission for nomination.  
 
 
7. Reports 
 
1. Treasurer’s Report 
 
M. Bouchett gave report in place of C. Haessly. Discussed budget, all looks on track.  
S. McGinnis confirms this although budget is tight going into the holiday season. Noted 
budget is available upon request.  
 
2. Director’s Report 
S. McGinnis spoke about Howl’ween event and its success. New Sponsor, Dorset Street 
Animal Hospital. Whizbang’s event was successful as well. Attention now turns to the 
holidays. Thanked maintenance team for  all of their hard work as well as CSM team. 
Holidays on the Marketplace kicks off this weekend with arrival of the tree. Went on to 
give overview of events coming up. Gave update on Winter In The City, working with 
other City departments, BCA, Parks, Fletcher Free Library. Winter Fest Jan -Feb. 
Valentine’s Market in Feb. Potential cross country ski race down church street. Note d 
Mayor’s Business meeting this coming Friday with the new Police Chief. Gave vacancy 
updates, new business, Burlington Souvenirs, new crepe business coming. 150 Church 
Street has new owners, Summer Lion Fine Art gallery now in that space. No new 
businesses closed in October.  
 
3. Chair’s Report 
 
M. Bouchett noted Lake Champlain Chamber has taken over the previous role of the BBA 
with the creation of the Downtown Business Alliance. Acknowledged hiring of new Police 
Chief Geraci. .
Church Street Marketplace Commission Minutes   
 
 
 
8. Adjournment  
Action: Move to adjourn  
Time of Adjournment: 09:57 
Motion by: C. Haessly  
Seconded by: L. Magoon  
Vote: Passed Unanimously
